bom.specification: 6 V, 100 RPM target, 3 mm D shaft; all four identical
bom.alternative: Same N20 6 V 60 RPM: slower, greater reduction; encoder version if odometry needed
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Buy one first: gearbox length, 12×10 body, shaft length/flat, stall current. Robocraze ₹225 listing is unavailable; ₹300 cap uses a different seller. Mount redesign required.

bom.specification: 44–45 mm diameter; 3 mm D shaft; width/offset measured
bom.alternative: 42 mm N20 wheel, or TPU tyre on redesigned D-hub
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹35 each listing; confirm whether one or pair. Set WHEEL_D to actual 44 mm; bought wheel replaces printed wheel AND separate adapter.

bom.specification: One bridge per motor, four independent channels; 3.3 V input
bom.alternative: Same DRV8833 at Zbotic; TB6612FNG only after stall/thermal check
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Choose real chip/carrier; full-current TI package differs from 500 mA PW package. Budget module seller claims 1.2 A; prove thermal margin. Fit new mounting holes.

bom.specification: Header-equipped PCB-antenna DevKitC-compatible; USB; 3.3 V GPIO
bom.alternative: WROOM-32 DevKit for control only; confirm available pins/firmware
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Evelta headline ₹910.96 incl GST; selectable board variants differ. Advertised 64×25 mm board is too long for current 58×32 tray. Use a carrier cradle.

bom.specification: ESP32-CAM with included OV3660; 5 V board input; Wi-Fi stream
bom.price_status: Live JSON ₹689; stock conflicts with cached page
bom.alternative: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense camera board
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Intentional two-board budget architecture: S3 controls motors, camera streams independently. JSON says available; web snapshot says sold out. Confirm checkout and exact sensor pin map; CAM is classic ESP32, not S3.

bom.specification: USB-UART with 3.3 V signal levels or matching ESP32-CAM-MB base
bom.alternative: Existing USB-UART adapter with verified 3.3 V TX/RX
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Needed if camera has no USB; its board needs adequate 5 V power, not a weak 3.3 V UART regulator.

bom.specification: I²C, exposed XSHUT; 3.3 V-safe bus and regulator-compatible input
bom.alternative: Same VL53L0X breakout at another seller; VL53L1X with firmware/bracket change
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Default 7-bit address 0x29; initialize separately to e.g. 0x30/31/32. Buy actual breakout, not bare sensor. Three independent bracket angles.

bom.specification: 7.4 V nominal / 8.4 V full; ~850–1000 mAh; ≥10 A verified discharge
bom.alternative: 2S 850 mAh GNB/CNHL from hobby supplier
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: PRICE/stock/dimensions unverified. Original 62×32 opening has no floor and is probably too shallow. Obtain L/W/H and connector exits before tray redesign.

bom.specification: 2S-capable 4.20 V/cell; mains input or include required adapter
bom.alternative: Genuine SkyRC B6neo plus required power source
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: B3 is a lower-cost 2S/3S option (~₹332 category snapshot); verify quality/cell current. TP4056 is single-cell and cannot charge this pack.

bom.specification: 2S → 5.5–6.0 V; ≥5 A continuous demonstrated at selected input
bom.alternative: Two adequately rated 3 A motor regulators, one per side
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Prevents full 8.4 V from reaching 6 V motors. Must handle four starts and braking energy; choose converter/TVS clamp arrangement after tests; LM2596 labelled 3 A is not a proven 5 A solution.

bom.specification: 2S → 5.0 V; ≥2 A continuous, low ripple
bom.alternative: Quality 5 V 2–3 A BEC
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Separate motor and logic branches. 5 V goes to board input, not GPIO; sensor input per breakout schematic.

bom.specification: 2S cell monitor plus firmware stop; hardware cutoff if unattended
bom.alternative: Protected high-discharge 2S Li-ion pack with appropriate BMS
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Alarm alone does not disconnect load. Use ADC divider/cell monitor and test disconnect behaviour; confirm per-cell thresholds with pack maker.

bom.specification: DC fuse close to battery; spare fuse; provisionally 5 A
bom.alternative: Blade fuse holder from auto electrical shop
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Final rating from starts and measured current; must be below wire/connector safe limit. Motor wiring differs from main wiring.

bom.specification: DC-rated ≥10 A at battery voltage; accessible
bom.alternative: Removable XT30 disconnect + rated motor enable switch
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: CAD has no switch aperture or switch bracket; add before printing.

bom.specification: Genuine matching male/female, insulated; battery and charging lead
bom.alternative: Match existing pack connector using a rated adapter
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Confirm pack polarity and included plugs; JST-PH signal connectors are not main power substitutes.

bom.specification: ~1 m each red/black 18–20 AWG main, motor 22 AWG; ~3 m 26 AWG signal
bom.alternative: Local stranded copper cable in equivalent cross-section
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Gauge is a starting plan; validate voltage drop/current and protect against wheel rubbing. Avoid copper-clad aluminium.

bom.specification: At least 8 locking 2/4/6-pin pairs for boards, sensors and motors
bom.alternative: Soldered harness + heat shrink for prototype
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Use correct pitch; crimp contacts count with housings. Dupont is bench-only under vibration.

bom.specification: 4×100 nF ceramics at motors; 2×470 µF ≥16 V driver bulk; 1×470 µF logic; 100 nF local bypass
bom.alternative: 220–1000 µF bulk chosen from ripple/start measurements
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Bulk caps complement existing carrier caps. Add input clamp/filter for regen on buck-fed motor rail; choose clamp voltage against driver limit.

bom.specification: ~50×70 mm, headers and screw terminals
bom.alternative: Small custom PCB later
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Add rigid carrier mount and connector strain relief; no solderless breadboard in final mobile chassis.

bom.specification: M3×8 (20), ×12 (12), ×16 (8), ×45 (6 if using through-bolted printed spacers); nuts (40), washers (40); M2×6 (12) + nuts/spacers
bom.alternative: Local metric hardware, nylon spacers for electronics
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Planning quantities with spares; final screw lengths depend on corrected stack. Camera/ToF board holes may be M2, not M3; threaded metal spacers use short screws instead of long through bolts.

bom.specification: ~32 mm at present reference; final CAD-derived length, M3 bore
bom.alternative: Printed tubular spacer with through bolt
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current 32 mm spacers leave 2 mm gap. Once base top is fixed, length = deck underside minus base top; add matched holes.

bom.specification: 10–15 mm hook-and-loop + foam pad
bom.alternative: Hook-and-loop tape through new slots
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Keep straps away from terminals; new slots and solid battery floor required.

bom.specification: Corrected PETG chassis/modules; estimated 200–300 g incl failed fit tests
bom.alternative: PLA indoor prototype; paid print service if no printer
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Material/own-printer allowance, not a print-service quote. Wheels are purchased; do not print assembly STL. External printing may cost substantially more.

bom.specification: S3 USB connector matched, 0.5–1 m
bom.alternative: Existing tested data cable
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: A charge-only cable cannot program the controller.

bom.specification: Heat shrink, cable ties, foam, labels, solder, strain relief
bom.alternative: Existing workshop stock
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Protect all moving clearances; reserve space for antenna, regulator ventilation and plug access.

bom.specification: 12 V, 60 RPM, quadrature A/B, 6 mm D shaft; matching four
bom.alternative: RMCS-3012 60 RPM quadrature (~₹1500 indexed) if encoders must remain; cheap Rhino GB37 without encoder or premium Pololu #4755 as separate trade-offs
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹650 cap provisional: EngineersToy live fetch blocked. Confirm exact encoder variant, stall/current and mount/shaft offset. RMCS needs new brackets, shaft-length and 5V encoder checks; four add ≥₹3400 and may exceed budget. Nonencoder GB37 loses PID/odometry.

bom.specification: 90–100 mm, ~20–32 mm wide; complete metal clamp hub where possible
bom.alternative: 90 mm 6 mm-ID Robokits wheel, or 12 mm-hex RC tyre + matching 6 mm adapter
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹250/each is purchasing cap, not verified quote. Match 6 mm bore, shaft flat, hub offset, fastening pattern and retention. BO double-flat holes are not automatically compatible.

bom.specification: Clamp or radial set screw, matches wheel holes/hex and shaft engagement
bom.alternative: Integrated 6 mm locking wheel saves separate hub
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Skip only if R02 includes proper retention. Current printed hub cannot transmit torque reliably and wheel lacks its bolt pattern.

bom.specification: Purchased-motor face pattern, pilot boss and chassis foot
bom.alternative: Custom bent/cut 2–3 mm aluminium plate; Pololu 37D bracket for Pololu only
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current generic 62×62×8 flat plate needs redesign/foot; buy matched brackets or fabricate from measured drawing.

bom.specification: Two independent motors per board; 5–30 V, 10 A continuous/channel
bom.price_status: Live Evelta ₹1,886.82 incl GST; checkout stock ambiguous
bom.alternative: Four BTS7960/IBT-2 single-channel modules (~₹250–450 each)
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: One channel per motor. Primary manufacturer confirms 10 A, not retailer 13 A text. No reverse-polarity protection. Current motor variant must meet channel limits.

bom.specification: Header-equipped PCB-antenna DevKit, 8 encoder inputs, 8 drive outputs
bom.alternative: ESP32 WROOM-32 DevKit; GPIO/PCNT redesign needed
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not use XIAO without extra pin planning; current tray holes are generic, advertised 64 mm board leaves little cable margin.

bom.specification: 11.1 V nominal / 12.6 V full, Bonka 2200 mAh 35C, XT60
bom.alternative: Original 4S LiFePO4 15 Ah pack after BMS/current/dimension confirmation
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Budget substitution drops nominal energy from 192 Wh to 24.42 Wh (~7.9× less). Verify C-rating authenticity; add per-cell cutoff. Charger chemistry changes.

bom.specification: 3S 4.20 V/cell balance charging, AC input
bom.alternative: Genuine SkyRC charger + appropriate power source
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: May be shared with compact pack; no LFP charger in this 3S build. Check actual balance connector pitch/current and three-cell readout.

bom.specification: 3S → 5 V, ≥2 A verified, filtered
bom.alternative: Quality 5 V BEC
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: This budget regulator is for ESP32/sensors only. Replace/add the Pi-rated supply before Pi upgrade.

bom.specification: 3S balance connector alarm + MCU voltage stop + appropriate hardware cutoff
bom.alternative: Pack with documented integrated high-current protection
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Typical RC LiPo has no BMS; alarm is not cutoff. Thresholds from pack spec, stop before a low cell and leave power recovery margin.

bom.specification: Eight channels 5 V→3.3 V where needed; two 4-channel unidirectional buffers
bom.alternative: Resistor dividers for eight verified push-pull outputs at tested encoder frequency
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Power buffers at 3.3 V and verify their inputs tolerate 5 V. Use pullups instead only when encoder outputs are confirmed open collector. Generic slow I²C shifter is not preferred for fast edges.

bom.specification: 3.3 V-safe I²C breakout; forward-facing
bom.alternative: HC-SR04 budget ultrasound with 5 V echo divider; VL53L1X upgrade
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: One sensor baseline, add two later. Short-range ToF is not a 360° scan or outdoor mapping sensor.

bom.specification: Two ~330 mm rails + two crossmembers, 20×20 extrusion or angle; four corner brackets; 16 matching T-nuts/bolts if extrusion
bom.alternative: Local 20×20 aluminium angle and drilled crossmembers
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Fabrication cap; not matching current solid SCAD bars. Angle joints use through bolts instead of T-nuts. Rotate crossmembers across rails, prepare cut/drill drawing and check flex. Flat plate only if redesigned load path needs one.

bom.specification: Small ventilated/splash-guard box with mounting carrier
bom.alternative: Printed PETG cover with cable grommets
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Waterproofness is unproven; ensure airflow and driver clearance, keep connectors reachable.

bom.specification: Corrected PETG trays/brackets/bumper, ~150–250 g
bom.alternative: Local fabrication for trays; existing filament
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Own-printer material allocation only. Excludes structural rails/wheels; external print quotes can exceed cap.

bom.specification: DC blade holder + spare fuse; provisional 10–15 A for low-current motor variant
bom.alternative: Higher-rated documented holder only when current/pack require it
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not freeze rating before motor stall/current-limiting test. Rating protects the chosen main wire and connector.

bom.specification: DC-rated ≥20 A switch or accessible XT60 isolator
bom.alternative: Rated automotive battery switch
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: A household AC switch rating is insufficient evidence for DC interrupt rating.

bom.specification: Latching switch into hardware enable/qualified power switch path
bom.alternative: Latching DC-rated motor power switch within easy reach
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not run battery current through signal-only mushroom contacts. If contactor is needed, budget it separately; keep controller alive for diagnostics.

bom.specification: Insulated terminal/bar rated ≥planned fuse, ring terminals, branch terminals
bom.alternative: Covered automotive terminal strip
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Star return for logic/encoders; no motor current through Dupont or breadboard.

bom.specification: Battery disconnect and charger/harness; genuine matching set
bom.alternative: Reuse included battery mating plug if supplied
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Female exposed contact side convention must not replace polarity verification; insulate every joint.

bom.specification: Main ~1 m each red/black 16 AWG; motors ~4 m 20 AWG; signal ~5 m 26 AWG
bom.alternative: Equivalent stranded copper from auto-electrical supplier
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Illustrative low-current JGB choice only; upgrade gauge for higher current/long runs after voltage-drop/temperature checks.

bom.specification: 4×6-pin encoder harness sets (confirmed pitch), sensor and driver headers
bom.alternative: Locking screw terminal signal connectors
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Buy contacts/housings/crimp tool or precrimp leads; motor pin colour assignment varies by vendor.

bom.specification: 4×100 nF motor caps; driver bulk 2×470–1000 µF ≥25 V; 5 V bulk/local bypass
bom.alternative: Equivalent low-ESR parts sized from measured ripple
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Motor driver regen returns energy to battery; BMS disconnection/high-full-pack conditions need clamp assessment. No single diode across bidirectional motor.

bom.specification: M4×10 (20), ×16 (20), ×20 (12); M3×6/8/10 (12 each); locknuts/washers, electronics spacers
bom.alternative: Local metric hardware; nylon/metal electronics spacers
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Planning counts; final joint drawing required. Motor screws must not exceed maker thread-depth limit; Pi uses M2.5 later.

bom.specification: 15–20 mm hook-and-loop + anti-slip insulating foam
bom.alternative: Mechanical clamp with insulated contact pads
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Tray needs solid bottom, retaining lips, matched holes and cable exit.

bom.specification: S3 USB connector matched
bom.alternative: Shared cable from compact build
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Later Pi↔S3 needs tested short data cable and protection against USB power backfeed.

bom.specification: Cable ties, grommets, heat shrink, solder, labels, foam
bom.alternative: Existing workshop stock
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: This and enclosure provide basic splash guards only, not a weatherproof rating.

bom.specification: 4 GB is a reasonable initial ROS/vision option; 8 GB for heavier workloads
bom.alternative: Use an existing laptop over local network; used full-working Pi 4 after test
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹9,000 is allowance, not verified current price. Changes in Pi pricing make historic ₹5–6k unsafe to assume. No Pi required for base teleoperation.

bom.specification: Official Pi 5 active cooler, accessible airflow
bom.alternative: Compatible fan/heatsink with proven sustained cooling
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Check cooler height, port access and fan header; protect from wheel spray.

bom.specification: 32–64 GB endurance A1/A2 from reputable seller
bom.alternative: Existing tested card or NVMe + HAT at higher cost
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Capacity/speed chosen to workload; image and backup. Generic unbranded cards create intermittent faults.

bom.specification: Battery → regulated ~5.1 V ≥5 A continuous, Pi-compatible USB-C PD delivery
bom.alternative: Qualified fused 5 V GPIO supply by experienced builder; powered USB hub as needed
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Bare 5 A buck + USB-C adapter does not prove 5 A negotiation. Test voltage at Pi under CPU+USB load; firmware USB limit must match a real supply.

bom.specification: SLAMTEC RPLIDAR A1 kit, USB interface and cable included; revision recorded
bom.alternative: YDLIDAR X2/X4 kit after Linux/ROS driver test; used genuine unit
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Estimate ₹8–12k class, no live quote. Model revisions vary range. Single ToF on servo is not an equivalent SLAM sensor. Plate holes must match actual device.

bom.specification: 6-axis I²C/SPI e.g. ICM-42688 class, documented 3.3 V interface
bom.alternative: Budget MPU6050 (~₹150–250) after authenticity/calibration checks
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Mount firmly, define orientation, timestamp and calibration; magnetometer near motors often unreliable.

bom.specification: Camera Module 3/compatible UVC; front-facing rigid bracket
bom.alternative: ESP32-CAM ₹689 for streaming; not a direct CSI/ROS camera replacement
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Pi 5 needs 22-pin cable to appropriate camera end; current camera slot is not a board mounting pattern.

bom.specification: Pi 5 22-pin to camera 15-pin, correct connector orientation/length
bom.alternative: UVC camera with USB data cable eliminates CSI cable
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not buy old 15→15 cable for Pi 5.

bom.specification: M2.5 screws/nuts and four ≥6 mm spacers; carrier with 58×49 pattern
bom.alternative: Printed insulating spacers with M2.5 hardware
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current CAD M3 3.4 mm clearance is loose; redesign for actual M2.5 board holes and board offset/ports.

bom.specification: Left/right, exposed XSHUT
bom.alternative: Reuse one forward sensor until needed
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Add bracket angles, two XSHUT pins; avoid duplicated addresses.

bom.specification: Four rigid posts plus cross-braced short mast if LiDAR requires
bom.alternative: Short aluminium tube mast with flange plates
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current LiDAR mast is detached and incorrectly bored; add real through holes and deck supports.

bom.specification: Short Pi↔S3 USB data cable; powered USB hub if USB budget demands
bom.alternative: Direct short USB/UART link with documented power scheme
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Account for Pi USB current allocation, boot brownouts and supply backfeed.

bom.specification: 4S LiFePO4 12.8 V nominal, 14.6 V-class full, 192 Wh nominal
bom.alternative: Documented high-current 4S LFP 6–10 Ah pack; existing suitable pack
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹3519 is indexed category snapshot, live page not readable. Need L/W/H, mass, discharge and whether BMS included. Not same as 3S LiPo budget battery.

bom.specification: 4S LiFePO4, balancing/temperature, current >=actual load but <=cell/wire limits
bom.alternative: JBD 4S LFP matched-current variant
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Conditional: buy only if bare pack needs it. Do not duplicate integrated BMS or substitute Li-ion chemistry; BMS does not replace fuse.

bom.specification: Manufacturer-matched 4S LFP CC/CV, ~14.4–14.6 V, 2–3 A budget / 5 A faster
bom.alternative: Lower-current LFP charger matched to selected pack
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Follow exact pack charge voltage, not nominal chemistry alone. Quartz 6 Ah listing conflicts 14.4 V spec vs 14.6 V suggested charger; resolve before ordering. Never 16.8 V Li-ion.

bom.specification: Each: one 6 mm-ID 626-2RS (OD19×W6), redesigned carrier, one separate axle if needed, two collars and one matched coupling
bom.alternative: Separate 8 mm axle on 608 bearings plus 6-to-8 mm coupling
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Four kits imply four bearings, four carriers, up to four axles/couplings and eight collars. Current Ø22 cavity suggests 608 (8 mm-ID), not direct 6 mm support. Freeze radial load, axle length/alignment and retention before purchase.

bom.specification: Suitable shunt + amplifier for real branch current; 3.3 V output/bus
bom.alternative: Bench current measurement first; higher-range hall sensor after calibration
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Tiny module shunts/terminals may not tolerate main motor current. Optional per-channel sensors need four channels and budget.

bom.specification: Same voltage/ratio, A/B outputs compatible with 3.3 V MCU
bom.alternative: Keep nonencoder first build and add odometry later
bom.compatibility_and_purchase_checks: REPLACES C01, not additional four motors. Rear encoder adds length; eight more signals; redesign wiring/mount and check stall current.

findings.title: Base is shifted upward, causing negative ground clearance
findings.evidence: rounded_box(center=true) centres only X/Y and starts at Z=0. Additional BASE_T/2 makes base Z=2..6. Wheel bottom=26.5−22.5=4; underside is 2 mm below wheel ground plane.
findings.required_change: Place base at Z=0..4; choose ground clearance e.g. 5–8 mm and compute shaft Z = wheel radius − clearance with base datum 0. Rebuild motor/deck constraints together.

findings.title: Base mounting holes are blind
findings.evidence: Hole cutter Z=−1..5; base Z=2..6 leaves a 1 mm roof.
findings.required_change: Normalize base origin and use cuts extending past both faces.

findings.title: Base cable slots cut only lower face
findings.evidence: Centred height-6 cube translated Z=−1 gives −4..2; base begins at 2, so only coplanar contact, no useful through slot.
findings.required_change: Use a full-thickness slot cutter centred at true base midpoint plus epsilon.

findings.title: Battery tray is a bottomless ring
findings.evidence: Tray Z=0..7; centred void translated Z=3 has Z=−1..7, removing the entire floor.
findings.required_change: Add 2–3 mm floor, height matching pack, retaining lips, two strap slots and cable exit.

findings.title: Tray screw holes occupy cavity instead of proper mounting tabs
findings.evidence: Hole centres ±29/±15 are inside 62×32 opening (±31/±16), cutting only edge fragments.
findings.required_change: Add tabs outside battery cavity with bolt-head/nut clearance; choose holes shared by chassis.

findings.title: Standoffs miss the deck and base holes
findings.evidence: Standoffs Z=4..36; deck underside=38, so 2 mm gap. Their XY ±50/±30 do not match base grid ±60/±30/0 × ±35/0.
findings.required_change: Tie four base/deck holes to one shared array and derive spacer length from mating surfaces.

findings.title: Deck centre opening leaves a roof
findings.evidence: Centred height-5 cutter at Z=37 reaches only Z=39.5; deck Z=38..41 leaves 1.5 mm roof.
findings.required_change: Cut through Z=38..41 plus epsilon; add protected wire edges.

findings.title: Wheels overlap chassis sides
findings.evidence: Wheel tyre inner Y=58.5−7=51.5, base edge=52.5, giving 1 mm lateral intrusion. At wheel low arc Z=4..6 this is physical solid intersection.
findings.required_change: Position wheel from motor shaft engagement/offset and ≥1–2 mm assembled moving clearance, then re-check entire rotation.

findings.title: Gearbox intersects wheel hub and shaft engagement is incomplete
findings.evidence: Right motor centre Y=42.5; gearbox Y=55..61. Wheel centre=58.5, integral hub Y=50.5..66.5 with Ø3.2 bore. Ø12 gearbox occupies that hub bore region. Shaft Y=61..69 gives only 5.5 mm engagement within 16 mm integral hub.
findings.required_change: Use exact motor face-to-shaft dimensions and actual bought wheel hub depth; resolve gearbox/hub collision before print.

findings.classification: Motor fit risk; exact profile unverified
findings.title: N20 cavity models a cylinder instead of rectangular motor
findings.evidence: N20_BODY_H=10 is unused. 12×10 rectangular body diagonal is 15.62 mm; largest cylindrical cavity is Ø13.5. A full rectangular envelope cannot fit; actual rounded-can fit needs measurement.
findings.required_change: Model rounded rectangular can/gearbox profiles, tolerances and retaining clamp from measured motor.

findings.title: Mount insertion cut is asymmetric on the wrong local axis
findings.evidence: Cut cube spans X=−16..0, Y=−22..0; every mount uses same transform, despite comment saying mirror for opposite side.
findings.required_change: Design insertion access in shaft-side/inward direction, explicitly mirror/clamp left and right variants.

findings.title: Motor mounts have no working chassis fastening/retention
findings.evidence: Two local screws ±10 map to X=±42/±62,Y=±42.5; base grid has neither. Cutter stops Z=10 in mount Z=4..29; no defined accessible screw head/nut or motor clamp.
findings.required_change: Add foot/flange, shared base holes, head/nut pockets, clamp screws and cable clearance.

findings.title: Wheel adapter splits into two disconnected halves
findings.evidence: Full-height 1.2 mm slot crosses entire hub diameter. Axial holes at X=±5 do not join the halves radially; wheel has no matching bolt holes or adapter pocket.
findings.required_change: Prefer purchased D-shaft wheel; otherwise closed slotted clamp with cross bolt and wheel bolt/pocket interface.

findings.title: Round bore has no torque lock
findings.evidence: Ø3.2 wheel / Ø3.25 adapter on Ø3 D shaft has no D flat, radial set screw or designed interference; adapter omitted from assembly.
findings.required_change: Use D-shaped bore or metal clamping hub and axial retention; do not assume loose round bore transmits torque.

findings.title: Bumper is detached and projects into wheel envelope
findings.evidence: Bumper Y=−61.5..−53.5 versus base minimum Y=−52.5 gives 1 mm gap. Its X width overlaps side wheel positions at the bumper Z span.
findings.required_change: Move actual front to chassis X end, add bolt tabs and swept wheel clearance; evaluate TPU option.

findings.title: Sensors/bumper labelled front are on lateral edge
findings.evidence: Length/front-rear declared X, wheel shafts along Y, so rolling direction is ±X. Camera/ToF/bumper are on −Y (left/right side).
findings.required_change: Adopt one axis convention and move/aim front sensors at −X or redefine all drivetrain coordinates consistently.

findings.title: Camera fixture floats and orientation is unresolved
findings.evidence: camera_mount bottom Z=42; deck top=41 gives 1 mm gap. Horizontal 36×24 slot fixture is not actual camera PCB pattern; camera_front_mount exists but is never called.
findings.required_change: Use camera-specific forward bracket with shared holes, adjustment, lens opening and ribbon/connector clearance.

findings.title: ESP tray fastening pattern does not match deck
findings.evidence: Tray holes translate to X=−1/45,Y=0/24; deck has only four ±50/±30 holes and partial centre opening. Tray rests on deck without fasteners.
findings.required_change: Add carrier mounting holes independent from actual board holes and model underside solder/header clearance.

findings.title: ToF bar has circular apertures but no PCB interface
findings.evidence: Three Ø8 holes along Z do not define forward pointing PCBs; no breakout dimensions, M2 holes, left/right angle or chassis tab matches.
findings.required_change: Create three named angled PCB brackets from selected sensor drawings; keep optics clear of printed walls.

findings.title: Battery tray height depends on erroneous base datum
findings.evidence: Current tray bottom Z=6 touches erroneous base top=6, but holes do not match; if base-origin fix is made alone it introduces a 2 mm gap. Capacity/type dimensions absent.
findings.required_change: Constrain tray bottom to corrected base top, fit exact pack including connector and straps; do not change only one Z constant.

findings.title: Wheel tread comment and production thickness disagree
findings.evidence: Comment says six grooves; loop 0:30:330 creates twelve. WHEEL_W=14 versus design document 12; deck 38 versus document 42–45.
findings.required_change: Use one dimensional source and update prose/counts; design tread/material against actual tyre.

findings.title: Individual exports retain assembly Z transforms
findings.evidence: top_cover exports at Z=38, bumper at Z=10; wheels/hub span negative Z; standoffs export four positioned parts.
findings.required_change: Separate local printable geometry from placement transforms; normalise each printable part to Z≥0 and document copies.

findings.title: Crossmembers do not cross the chassis
findings.evidence: Both 250×24 members have length along X and are at Y=±55. Rails lie at ±125. Crossmember Y edge=67; rail inner edge=111 leaves 44 mm gap.
findings.required_change: Rotate crossmembers 90° about Z, place at selected X positions, create four joints and matched holes/angle brackets.

findings.title: Motors, motor plates, hubs and bearings absent from assembly
findings.evidence: assembly calls only wheels. motor_mount, motor_placeholder, wheel_hub and wheel_bearing_block are defined but unused. Wheels have no physical connection to frame.
findings.required_change: Add four measured motors, face planes, brackets, hubs, shafts and fixation; model optional bearing supports only if actually used.

findings.title: 37D hole circle is wrong
findings.evidence: Six 60° holes at R=17.9 create 17.9 mm neighbour spacing. Stated reference is 15.5 mm neighbours / Ø31 circle, so R must be 15.5. MOTOR_HOLE_NEIGHBOR unused.
findings.required_change: Use purchased-motor measured PCD/offset/pattern, not generic equivalence; for published Pololu drawing set R=15.5 and correct plate opening.

findings.title: Correcting hole circle alone breaks screw seats
findings.evidence: Current central opening radius=15; corrected M3 clearance radius 1.7 around R=15.5 extends inward to 13.8, overlapping opening by 1.2 mm.
findings.required_change: Reduce opening to actual shaft/pilot-boss clearance with adequate material around each screw and washer; check reference pilot dimensions.

findings.title: Motor plate has no suitable frame foot/orientation
findings.evidence: Plate is local XY, normal Z, but wheel shafts are Y. No L foot, rotated location or chassis mating pattern.
findings.required_change: Use metal L-bracket with vertical face normal Y, finite foot and matched frame holes; reserve screw-tool access.

findings.title: Wheel intersects rails and bumpers
findings.evidence: Wheel Y=134..166 overlaps side rail Y=111..139 by 5 mm; at X near ±150,Z=0..24 wheel solid crosses rail. Bumpers Y=±138..162,Z=20..48 overlap wheels too.
findings.required_change: Increase track from actual frame/shaft/hub/tyre offsets or cut/reposition members; add dynamic clearances and redefine front bumpers at X ends.

findings.title: Zero frame underside ground clearance
findings.evidence: Rails start Z=0; wheel bottom=50−50=0. Structure sits on ground plane.
findings.required_change: Specify ≥20–30 mm provisional clearance for this terrain aim and tie rail/motor locations to it; validate payload/load and actual obstacle height.

findings.title: Declared structural footprint is not model-controlled
findings.evidence: BASE_L=360, BASE_W=290 and BASE_T=5 are unused. Rail length 330, outer width 278; bumpers to Y±162; wheels span X±200,Y±166.
findings.required_change: Derive member lengths, wheelbase, track and bumper positions from parameters; label structural footprint separately from 400×332 overall envelope.

findings.title: Battery tray has a roof rather than an open top
findings.evidence: Tray local Z=0..12; centred void Z=−8..8 removes bottom to 8, leaving top slab Z=8..12. Battery cannot drop into it from above.
findings.required_change: Start cavity above a solid floor and cut out past top; resize exact battery, add straps, lips and tabs.

findings.title: Battery mounting holes are in roof over cavity
findings.evidence: Centres ±95/±35 lie inside cavity ±100/±40 and drill roof. No deck/shared frame bolt pattern or battery restraint.
findings.required_change: Place mounting tabs outside cavity, grounded to supported deck; keep fasteners clear of cell casing.

findings.title: Electronics and compute decks have no supports
findings.evidence: Electronics bottom=35 vs rails top=24 gives 11 mm gap. Battery bottom=48 vs electronics top=43 gives 5 mm gap. Pi/ESP mounts bottom=60 with no defined supported connection.
findings.required_change: Add posts at matching holes and explicit load path; put heavy battery low, compute above with airflow and service access.

findings.title: Electronics cable channels remain capped
findings.evidence: Height-12 centred cube at Z=−1 reaches Z=5; tray thickness=8 leaves 3 mm roof.
findings.required_change: Make real through channels with grommet/strain relief or label intentionally blind channels and route accordingly.

findings.title: Pi ventilation opening remains capped
findings.evidence: Same centred cube reaches Z=5 in 8 mm plate, leaving 3 mm plastic over supposed opening.
findings.required_change: Through cut and validate Pi underside clearance, airflow, cooler and connector access.

findings.title: LiDAR mast is above and detached from plate
findings.evidence: Plate Z=105..113; mast Z=160..280 gives 47 mm gap above plate rather than support beneath it. Plate itself unsupported.
findings.required_change: Use short mast between supported deck and plate; model upper/lower flanges, hole patterns, cable exit and torsional restraint.

findings.title: LiDAR cable bore is blind for almost half its height
findings.evidence: Centred 125 mm bore at Z=−1 extends −63.5..61.5 in 120 mm mast, leaving top 58.5 mm solid. Screw holes reach only Z=19.
findings.required_change: Bore full height plus epsilon and add upper fastening/cable relief; eliminate dangling mast until chosen sensor needs one.

findings.title: Wheel hub cannot lock onto D shaft
findings.evidence: Ø6.15 round bore on 6 mm D shaft, no D flat, radial screw or clamp; hub 20 mm long may exceed Pololu 16 mm shaft after plate loss.
findings.required_change: Metal clamping hub matched to shaft and chosen wheel; budget shaft engagement, motor face plate and bearing spacing.

findings.title: Wheel has no hub fastening pattern
findings.evidence: Hub has four M4 holes on radius 15 at 45/135/225/315°, wheel only has Ø6.2 bore. No pockets/holes/axial retention marry them.
findings.required_change: Add matching wheel holes/nut recesses or buy wheel+hub kit; locate clamping screw and verify all fasteners accessible.

findings.title: Bearing cavity has no compatible shaft or retention design
findings.evidence: 22 mm OD cavity suggests 608 bearing (8 mm ID), whereas shaft is 6 mm. 16 mm-deep open bore has no shoulder/cap/fit tolerance.
findings.required_change: If support needed, use chosen 6 mm-ID bearing such as 626 with changed OD19 seat, retain both races appropriately and provide axle/collar/alignment.

findings.title: Rounded side panel violates its requested width
findings.evidence: rounded_box 330×5 with r=5 requires at least 10 mm width, but centres at Y±2.5 produce overall width15 mm. Horizontal holes are centred Z=0, creating half holes at bottom.
findings.required_change: Assert 2r≤min(x,y), reduce radius or use true thin panel geometry; move hole centres above edge with proper mounting tabs.

findings.title: Camera/ToF and front bumpers on side, without mating tabs
findings.evidence: Wheel axes Y mean driving X. Sensors at Y=−155/−160 and bumper Y=±150 are lateral; no actual PCB interfaces/support.
findings.required_change: Move forward sensors to X end, add angled bracket patterns for exact boards and defined frame attachment.

findings.title: Pi hole spacing correct but fastener/board interface incomplete
findings.evidence: 58×49 nominal grid is plausible, but clearance uses M3=3.4; actual Pi board uses M2.5-compatible mounting. Board outline, hole offset, solder, cooler/cables not modelled.
findings.required_change: Use manufacturer mechanical drawing, M2.5 spacers, real board offset and port cable clearance; mount never rests PCB on solid plate.

findings.title: LiDAR grid is not a sensor-specific mount
findings.evidence: 110×110 generic grid offers no chosen scanner mounting pattern, connector envelope or scan-plane clearance. Mast, battery/compute volumes omitted.
findings.required_change: Pick scanner kit, import mechanical drawing, keep 360° optical plane unoccluded and vibration restrained.

findings.title: SCAD solid rails differ from intended aluminium construction
findings.evidence: 330×28×24 solid bars with vertical holes are not 2020 extrusion or angle profiles; no T-nuts, joints or cut/drill drawing.
findings.required_change: Create actual metal frame drawings/BOM with section/material and connection hardware; do not simply print bars and assume rugged strength.

findings.title: Motor placeholder does not establish a purchased-motor envelope
findings.evidence: Centred 65 mm cylinder plus partly overlapping 26.5 mm face and Ø6 shaft is illustrative; shaft offset, encoder and wire exits unmodelled. JGB37 and Pololu references differ.
findings.required_change: Choose exact motor SKU, body/gearbox/encoder length, face pilot, eccentricity and harness envelope; do not mix motor families.

findings.title: Compact STL is stale relative to current source
findings.evidence: Existing bounds X −77.4263..150, Y −67.5..105, Z 0..48.9263; extents 227.4263×172.5×48.9263. Current source X envelope −75..75; tyres/hubs Y about −66.5..66.5, motor placeholder shafts extend to ±69. File mtime also older.
findings.required_change: Archive existing STL as an unreleased historical artefact; regenerate separate parts only after corrected CAD is checked.

findings.title: Existing STL has a nonmanifold edge
findings.evidence: One edge from (−10,−16,24) to (10,−16,24) has four incident faces. No boundary edges; five vertex-connected components.
findings.required_change: Fix source tangency/union responsible in original source if available; regenerated part meshes must have exactly two incident faces per edge.

findings.title: Manufacturing exports incomplete
findings.evidence: Only one STL exists, for old complete compact assembly. No rugged STL and no per-part STLs; assembly exports include nonprinted placeholders/unjoined/fused geometry.
findings.required_change: Release explicit named part STLs/3MF, quantity/orientation table, source hash and dimensions; never print motor placeholders.

findings.title: Concept images referenced by documents are missing
findings.evidence: compact_rover_top.svg and rugged_rover_top.svg do not exist; images/ at repository root is empty. Existing assembled PNG is a preview, not proof of fit.
findings.required_change: Replace missing references with real current-source renders after CAD fixes and retain diagnostic drawings clearly labelled.

findings.title: No complete electrical or pin assignment design
findings.evidence: No schematic, selected board pin map, driver mounting, XSHUT/encoder level interface, wire routing or switch/power mounts in CAD.
findings.required_change: Freeze hardware pin plan, supply branches, harness and failure-stop logic; list mounts for every purchased board.

findings.classification: Likely documentation error; seller confirmation needed
findings.title: Encoder “11-wire” claim appears to confuse pulse count with conductors
findings.evidence: Rugged document calls the motor 11-wire. Manufacturer JGB37 example says 11 signals per motor revolution and shows six signal/power leads; selected listing live read blocked.
findings.required_change: Delete blanket 11-wire assumption; require purchased motor pinout. Establish PPR vs quadrature counts and gear ratio experimentally.

findings.title: 6 V N20 power baseline and driver peak rating are unresolved
findings.evidence: Compact document proposes 2S battery straight into drivers; full charge is 8.4 V vs recommended 6 V motor. DRV8833 RMS differs by package and board cooling.
findings.required_change: Use regulated motor rail with transient handling, or exact motor rated for selected rail; verify stall and current protection.

findings.title: Original rugged battery can overvolt a 12 V motor
findings.evidence: 4S LFP approaches 14.6 V, ~22% above 12 V. Motor tolerance not established; brake regeneration and BMS trips unanalysed.
findings.required_change: Verify motor permitted voltage or use suitable regulation/voltage selection. PWM duty reduction limits average drive but does not remove higher terminal pulses.

findings.title: Rugged terrain/payload goals have no quantified validation
findings.evidence: No total mass, centre of gravity, slope target, traction coefficient, radial motor load or suspension/articulation calculation. A rigid four-wheel chassis can lose contact on uneven ground.
findings.required_change: Set mass/slope/obstacle targets, model motor torque/load and tipping limits; test progressively. Treat terrain claims as targets, not verified capability.

findings.title: BOM baseline omits practical integration purchases
findings.evidence: No fixed camera programmer, Pi5-specific cable, level conversion, pack restraint, connectors/contact counts, regulator transients or exact hardware lengths.
findings.required_change: Use revised BOM plus optional inventory below; fastener lengths remain conditional on corrected joints.

findings.title: No print fit/tolerance or fabrication acceptance criteria
findings.evidence: No printer clearances for shafts/bearing seats/heat-set inserts; no metal plate drawings/load tests. $fn segmentation is adequate for visuals, not proof of shaft fit.
findings.required_change: Print bore/hole coupons, measure real motor/wheel, inspect F6 part mesh and slicer; record acceptance before full prints.

findings.title: Legacy Pololu reference is discontinued
findings.evidence: Research references #2826; manufacturer now marks obsolete and points to #4755, which is 100 RPM, not budget JGB 60 RPM.
findings.required_change: Update documentation and differentiate reference drawing from recommended purchasable SKU.
